description: Real keyframes, easing curves and durations measured/quoted from spec/components.css and src/index.css. Closed set — no invented animation names. This is the sole source of truth motion.pattern enums in sections/ and schema/pagespec.schema.json must cite.
measuredFrom: src/index.css:52; spec/components.css (line-cited per keyframe below); tailwind.config.cjs:177-183

sticky-bar-scroll.usage: landing template sticky bar hide/show on scroll direction, 500ms

dot-blink.usage: 5x5 #0077b5 LinkedIn-blue dot, used in logos and landing-page tags

vc-light-pass.definedIn: spec/pages/landing/components.css (compare widget, verbatim in spec/components.css lineage)
vc-light-pass.usage: Valley-vs-Competition light sweep on the Valley track

vc-trace-in.usage: Valley-vs-Competition trace redraw after a competitor selection

endorsement-pin.description: Section is position:sticky-pinned for the duration of a 2610px-tall scroll track (container >=601c); content fades/parallaxes with scroll offset, not a CSS animation.

jobs-pin.description: Jobs (.vstack) section pins similarly; see quirk 7.1 in spec/GRID.md for the 801-816px viewport edge case where pinning toggles off.

sticky-bar-direction-aware.description: Landing-template sticky bar (section 3.1) hides on scroll-down (translateY 79px, opacity 0) and reveals on scroll-up after ~100ms, animating over ~480-500ms with the sticky-bar-scroll easing curve.

globalRule: prefers-reduced-motion:reduce disables autoplay, pinning and keyframes site-wide (CLONE_SPEC.md:25). Every section's motion contract in sections/ MUST declare a reducedMotionFallback and every PageSpec node's motion object is schema-required to include one.
noLibraryUse: Site does not use GSAP, ScrollTrigger, Lenis, or any smooth-scroll library. Only plain CSS keyframes/transitions, requestAnimationFrame loops, scroll listeners, IntersectionObserver, and one Web Animations API use (showcase tab progress). Framer-authored hover variants use framer-motion only for nav/hero-copy/logo-wall hover states, the mobile-menu variant change, the logo tooltip, and the dot-blink loop.
closedSetNote: additionalProperties:false is enforced on the motion object in schema/pagespec.schema.json. A generated PageSpec may only reference pattern names present in this file's keyframes/scrollDrivenPatterns/easingCurves — never an invented animation.
